notes.title: Update 0.4.8 Released
notes.notes:
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where players were losing items when playing as a demon.
[/list]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added an information popup when a player is being kicked from the lobby.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.4.6 Released
notes.notes:
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed glowing plant on the Haunted House map.
[*] Fixed ragdoll collision.
[*] Fixed demon being visible when it wasn't supposed to be.
[*] Fixed demon animations not being played correctly.
[*] Fixed items that sometimes couldn't be dropped.
[*] Fixed an issue where players might lose their items after the end of the game.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player wasn't moved to the main menu when all players left the game.
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Increased player lobby limit to 8 players.
[*] Increased stamina regeneration speed.
[*] Made minor changes to the Haunted House map.
[/list]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added ability to kick players from the lobby.
[*] Now the demon can turn off the lights in phantom mode.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.3.4 Released
notes.notes:
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The bug that allowed players to join an ongoing game has been fixed.
[*] The bug that prevented unlocking achievements for levels has been fixed.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Item descriptions have been added to the market.
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The stamina amount has been increased.
[*] The rate of heart rate increase in dark areas has been decreased.
[*] The game economy has been optimized.
[/list]

notes.title: Spooky Men | Big Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The bug has been fixed where the player could spam the light button when the lights were destroyed.
[*] The bug has been fixed where the player could get stuck in the cabinet.
[*] The bug has been fixed where objects could appear under the map.
[*] The bug has been fixed where the player could spawn inside a wall.
[*] The bug has been fixed where the fourth player sometimes couldn't spawn.
[*] The bug has been fixed where player animations were not displayed correctly.
[*] The bug has been fixed where David's model was corrupted.
[*] The bug has been fixed where sometimes a giant player could be seen in the middle of the map.
[*] Many other known bugs have been fixed.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] The player detection in the light has been improved.
[*] The lighting display has been improved (now the light does not pass through walls)
[*] The player footsteps are now synchronized with other players.
[*] Now, when the lights malfunction, a corruption effect will appear.
[*] The player models have been improved.
[*] The player movement has been improved.
[*] The environmental sounds have been improved.
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The player and demon interfaces have been changed.
[*] The demon mechanics have been altered.
[*] The entire gameplay has been changed.
[*] The main menu has been changed.
[*] The game lore has been changed.
[*] The entire haunted house map has been reworked.
[/list]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] New achievements have been added.
[*] New jump scares have been added.
[*] Tutorial has been added.
[*] Shop with items has been added.
[*] New item has been added.
[*] More skin tones have been added.
[*] Sprint SFX has been added.
[/list]

And much, much more...
The entire game has been completely rebuilt from scratch.

notes.title: Version 0.0.5 released
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Bugfixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed "Ragdoll spawning" - a lot of ragdolls were spawned after death.
[*] Fixed "Start The Game" and "Search For Game" buttons - Sometimes you couldn't click on the buttons when leaving the game or being disconnected.
[*] Fixed "I can't join to friend's lobby" - yeah.. now it's working fine.. I guess.
[*] Fixed "4th player can't spawn" - well... that was akward.. now it's fixed.
[*] Fixed "The demon in rage mode couldn't kill players".
[*] Fixed "Game is creating multiple lobbies" - sometimes it might crash the game.
[*] Fixed "You couldn't place a trap in the second bathroom".
[*] Fixed "Spectator mode" - sometimes it might crash the game.
[*] Fixed "Rage progress sometimes increases, sometimes it does not".
[*] Fixed "The camera in spectator mode is bouncing for some players".
[*] Fixed "Wrong animations are playing on David and Clara" - when you were crouching, there wasn't a crouching animation.
[*] Fixed an issue where the indoor and outdoor ambient sounds weren't always changing.
[*] Fixed "Some items were clipping though objects".
[*] Fixed "Light rave mode" - "Now you can't spam the 'break light sound effect' on broken lights when clicking on them.
[*] Fixed "Player can't open the door".
[*] Fixed "I'am stuck in the wall!! help me please" - sometimes you might spawn inside the wall.
[*] Fixed "Rotation on Clara is not synchronized properly".
[/list]

[h2][b]Changes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed spawn points.
[*] Increased special tasks and generator progress speed time.
[*] Increased humans movement speed.
[*] Increased size of the key item.
[*] Added ability to play solo - now you can play singleplayer mode as a human.


[/list]

[b]See you in the next update! - Bob[/b]
